lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for most categories, as few kinds of change have at least two tests that agree after noise correction.
Home new_flow and finish redesign changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Home wait_info, sign_in hint, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, and adoption new_flow produced winning tests, though non-winning tests in these categories showed no clear effect.
Early predictions (Rounds 1 and 2) were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results.
Round 3 predictions were too low for winning changes, underestimating sign_in hint and choose_path copy tests.
Sign_in reorder changes caused negative effects or showed no clear effect across tests.

candidates.title: Account Recovery Search Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen informing users how to recover existing pets by signing into their original email account.
candidates.why: Support mail showed 8 complaints about missing or reset pets after signing in again, pointing to user confusion during authentication.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your original email to restore your previously created pets and items.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Pet Choice Audio Preview Flow
candidates.change: Add interactive sound preview buttons to pet choices during selection so users can hear pet vocalizations before choosing.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.5% with median time 89s; audible feedback increases emotional engagement before generation.

guard.reason: Adds audio vocalization previews to the pet selection screen without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Adoption new_flow showed strong past gains (+7.1%) on a step with high drop-off.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Companion Mascot Preview
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a split layout showcasing an animated mascot alongside pet details.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has high drop-off (69.5%); visual companion preview reinforces ownership motivation right before final confirmation.

guard.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate components to only include a mascot removes the required official stamp.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Safety Hint
candidates.change: Display a hint on the finish screen explaining where the desktop pet resides and how to reveal it via the system tray.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on desktop and 3 emails about confusion on hiding/controlling pets.

home_intro.hint: Look for your pet on your desktop display or right-click the system tray icon anytime to manage visibility.

guard.reason: Adds a desktop pet visibility hint on the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 35.2% of users; supported by 6 support emails and copy/hint changes carry low cost.

candidates.title: Interactive Photo Quality Checklist
candidates.change: Integrate an interactive photo quality checklist on the photo upload screen to guide custom pet image selection.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected results during adoption.

components.text: Photo requirements: clear lighting, front facing, high resolution

guard.reason: Adds a photo quality checklist component to the upload photos screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support tickets during adoption drop-off using a promising new_flow approach.

candidates.title: Interactive Wait Time Entertainment Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new interactive tips carousel screen before waiting finishes to keep users engaged during long generation times.
candidates.why: Home step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing significant drop-off before finishing.

new_wait_activities.headline: Preparing Your Pet Desktop Haven
new_wait_activities.body: While your companion is being rendered, try these fun interaction tips!

components.text: Right-click your pet on desktop to feed or play anytime.

guard.reason: Adds a new wait activities screen before the waiting screen, which is allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen increases friction; new flow/screen experiments have shown poor or negative lift.

candidates.title: Choose Path Grid Overview Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen into a structured grid comparing standard adoption with custom pet generation.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has a high mean time of 514s; prior path redesign tests showed strong positive potential.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Choose a pre-made pet or generate a custom companion from your photos.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose path screen into a grid while preserving both adoption and custom pet creation options.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path redesigns historically showed negative noise-corrected impact (-0.5%).

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick Reference Video
candidates.change: Embed a short video preview component on the final screen showing basic pet controls such as hiding, moving, and talking.
candidates.why: 3 support messages cited confusion over controlling, hiding, or talking to desktop pets after completing onboarding.

guard.reason: Adds a quick guide video component to the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Directly resolves 3 support tickets on the highest drop-off step using embedded UI elements.

candidates.title: Path Option Time Expectation Copy
candidates.change: Update headline and body copy on choose_path screen to state clear time estimates for instant vs custom paths.
candidates.why: Choose path mean duration is 514s; clear copy updates previously yielded winning test results.

choose_path.headline: Pick Your Companion Path
choose_path.body: Choose Instant Companion for 1-minute setup, or Custom Pet Creator to generate from photos.

guard.reason: Updates choose path copy with time estimates while keeping both path options and avoiding price mentions.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path copy changes consistently win (+3.1% over 2 tests) and require configuration only.

candidates.title: Sign In Desktop Account Benefits Checklist
candidates.change: Switch sign-in screen to a compact layout with a feature checklist emphasizing cloud save and pet protection.
candidates.why: 8 emails reported missing pets after re-authenticating; highlighting account benefits reduces sign-in bounce.

components.text: Cloud pet sync, multi-device access, automatic pet recovery

guard.reason: Redesigns sign-in screen layout with a benefits checklist without breaking any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail alignment (8 emails) on sign-in step with moderate expected gain.

picked: Sign In Desktop Account Benefits Checklist
